o1.text: Control at least 2 SPs at the start-of-turn checkpoint on your turn.

o2.text: Build a total of 3 structures adjacent to or on an SP or HQ.

o3.text: Have at least 8 ENE and 6 cards in your hand at the same time.

reward.text: Play 1 card at zero cost, then play 2 cards with their cost reduced by 1 ENE.

o3.text: Keep one of your Pivot units in play.

reward.text: Draw 3 cards; those cards cost 1 less ENE.

o3.text: Destroy at least 2 enemy units during the same turn of your own.

c1.text: Your opponents have destroyed a total of 2 of your heavy vehicles.

c2.text: The same opponent controls at least 2 SPs for 3 consecutive turns of their own.

c3.text: An opponent has destroyed your Commander.

reward.text: For each condition, 1 distinct vehicle ignores DEF on its next attack and 1 distinct infantry unit can act twice during the current round.

o2.text: Trigger Numerical Superiority against 3 different enemies.

o3.text: Have no ordinary cards left in your hand.

o1.text: Deal a total of 10 Bleeding damage.

o2.text: Put at least 2 units into play through tactics.

o3.text: Move one of your units within R6 of at least one active enemy HQ.

c2.text: The same opponent has more units than you for 3 consecutive turns of their own.

c3.text: An opponent has destroyed your Commander or one of your Pivots.

reward.text: During the current round, you may repeat 1 attack for each satisfied condition (maximum 3).

o2.text: Use 3 defensive abilities: DEF buffs or untargetability.

o3.text: Reduce your deck to 15 cards or fewer.

o1.text: Build a cluster of at least 3 allied structures connected by adjacency.

o3.text: Control the central SP for 2 consecutive turns of your own.

reward.text: Choose an active opponent: they lose half of their ENE reserve, rounded down.

o2.text: Take control of 2 units belonging to any enemy faction.

o3.text: Manipulate one or more opponents' ENE reserves a total of 5 times.

c1.text: The same opponent has more ENE than you for 3 consecutive turns of their own.

c2.text: Your opponents have destroyed a total of 6 of your units.

c3.text: At least one active opponent has 3 or more Pressure.

reward.text: For each condition, choose 1 distinct unit belonging to any active opponent: it is stunned for 1 turn of its owner.
